description: Source code for DobbySpecGenerator class, responsible for generating container specifications, managing mounts, environment variables, plugins, and network configurations for containerized applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: DobbySpecGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating container specifications, managing environment, mounts, plugins, and network configurations based on application and runtime settings.

methods.name: getWorkingDir
methods.description: Returns the working directory for the container based on application configuration and runtime parameters.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates the container specification JSON string based on application and runtime configurations, including environment variables, mounts, plugins, and network settings.

methods.name: createEnvVars
methods.description: Creates environment variables array for the container based on application and runtime configurations.

methods.name: createMounts
methods.description: Creates the list of bind mounts and other filesystem mounts for the container.

methods.name: createBindMount
methods.description: Creates a bind mount JSON object with specified source, destination, and mount flags.

methods.name: shouldEnableGpu
methods.description: Determines if GPU should be enabled based on configuration.

methods.name: getSysMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates system memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getGPUMemoryLimit
methods.description: Calculates GPU memory limit for the container.

methods.name: getVpuEnabled
methods.description: Checks if VPU (Video Processing Unit) should be enabled for the application.

methods.name: getCpuCores
methods.description: Returns a string representing the CPU cores to assign to the container.

methods.name: createRdkPlugins
methods.description: Creates the RDK plugin configuration JSON object.

methods.name: createIonMemoryPlugin
methods.description: Creates the IonMemory plugin configuration JSON object.

methods.name: createThunderPlugin
methods.description: Creates the Thunder plugin configuration JSON object.

methods.name: createOpenCDMPlugin
methods.description: Creates the OpenCDM plugin configuration JSON object.

methods.name: initialiseIonHeapsJson
methods.description: Initializes Ion heap configuration JSON data.

methods.name: createPrivateDataMount
methods.description: Creates a private data mount configuration JSON object.

methods.name: createFkpsMounts
methods.description: Creates FKPS file mounts and related tmpfs mount.

methods.name: createTmpfsMount
methods.description: Creates a tmpfs mount configuration JSON object.

methods.name: createResourceManagerMount
methods.description: Creates a resource manager socket bind mount JSON object.

methods.name: encodeURL
methods.description: Encodes a URL string using libcurl escape function.

methods.name: addHolePunchPortToSpec
methods.description: Adds a hole punch port configuration to the container spec for NAT traversal.
